trainingEnvironment: real BadugiGameController through JSONL Python bridge
reward: target seat terminal hand chip delta / active hand BB; zero at intermediate decisions
groupNotation: physical seats / occupied seats; live UI MTT uses six physical slots for two or three entrants
trainingGroupAllocation: Equal hand allocation across the ten groups; within each group cycle four opponent profiles and rotate the target seat among eligible seats
seedRule: No training, validation, or evaluation seed reuse; no evaluation seed selection after seeing outcomes
firstRunPurpose: Training mechanics and safety checkpoint only; stop and inspect observation, legality, chip conservation, loss and action mix before any longer run
checkpointRule: Stop at the explicitly requested hand count; 5k is a safety and cause-diagnosis gate, never automatic continuation or promotion
modelPublication: Forbidden until independent controller-session EV and uncertainty, actual browser model-use/fallback, legal action and amount, cash/MTT, opponent-distribution gates pass
postCandidateEvaluation: Before evaluating a learned candidate, freeze model/code/schema SHA, baseline CPU, distinct evaluation seeds, opponent mix, session count and length, minimum practical difference, and 95% session-cluster uncertainty by group; no seed cherry-picking or causal-paired claim for divergent sessions
trainingStartGate: Mac real-controller training may start after independent 96-slot audit, persisted UI-event check, masked action and chip conservation preflight, frozen seed/opponent plan, and Mac resources. Learned-model browser use/fallback, independent EV and Windows capacity are product-adoption or Windows-run gates after a candidate exists.
notes: This is the frozen first-run plan; it is not a training or evaluation result.
S01 v2 remains stopped; no other game Standard training precedes all D03 tiers.
Old 96-input ONNX weights are not assumed compatible with this contract.
MTT chip/hand does not establish ICM or payout strength.
